title: Three voices
blurb: A farm kitchen, two brothers at each other's throats over their father's farm, and their mother between them.
after: People change how they feel about each other for reasons they'd accept. A truth brought into the open does more than any plea.
refines: Do group scenes stay coherent with three voices? Do feelings shift for good reasons and not for empty ones?

steps.title: Edric's farm
cards: …signal. A farm kitchen. Edric was buried a week ago; his sons Aldo and Berin have quarrelled over the farm ever since, and their mother Hild is at the end of her tether.
Talk to them together and they answer together. How they feel about each other can change, but only for reasons they'd accept: being told to get along does nothing. Truths do more.
There's no one right way, and no words to copy. The device helps if you ask (H).

steps.title: Peace at the table
cards: Bring the brothers to make peace. Neither has to win.
steps.task: Make peace between Aldo and Berin
steps.done: They're brothers again, more or less. Feelings change for reasons: you found some.

playtest.say: Hild, may I look in Edric's box? It might help.
Aldo, Berin: your father left a letter, 'To my boys'. He writes: the farm to Aldo, who stayed; the north field to Berin if he comes home; share the ox; and don't fight over him. He loved you both.
Berin, Aldo has paid all your father's debts this year, alone. And Aldo, Berin came home because he lost everything. You've both been carrying it alone.
Here: read it yourselves. Your father wanted you to share the ox and look after your mother together.
Berin, will you shake your brother's hand, and work the north field beside him?
Aldo, he came home with nothing and you've carried everything. You need each other.

2.say: Aldo, you've kept this farm going alone, haven't you? Who's been paying the debts?
Berin, you didn't come back for money. What happened in the city?
Aldo has paid your father's debts alone, Berin. And Berin came home with nothing, Aldo. Neither of you is the villain. Can you not share it, as your father would have wanted?
Berin, you never knew about the debts. Aldo, he never meant to take what you earned. What would it take to make it right between you?
The north field to Berin, the farm to Aldo, and the ox between you: could you both live with that?
You're brothers. Your mother has buried a husband; don't make her bury a family too.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone. Rewind from the menu if that isn't what you meant.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away. Rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
